diagnosis.root_cause: A rollout of order-router caused hosts h7 and h8 to run on a previous build where the ROUTE_MODE flag was interpreted as the legacy routing path, resulting in duplicate order submissions.
evidence: order-router / erroneous_order_rate spiked starting at 14:32 UTC (reaching max 0.1224)
2026-10-28T14:32:00Z order-router WARN hosts h7,h8 on previous build: ROUTE_MODE flag interpreted as the legacy routing path
2026-10-28T14:34:00Z order-router ERROR duplicate order submissions detected from the legacy routing path (h7,h8): 220 affected orders
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Roll back or update the build on hosts h7 and h8 so that the ROUTE_MODE flag is correctly interpreted instead of defaulting to the legacy routing path. Follow up by auditing the routing flag configuration parser to prevent incorrect interpretations during rolling updates.
